import ctypes
import os

# Load the libraries in the correct order
ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

# Define the gsl_rng structure
class GSLRng(ctypes.Structure):
    pass

# Define the function prototypes for GSL random number generator
# gsl_rng_alloc, gsl_rng_set, and gsl_rng_free

# gsl_rng_alloc returns a pointer to a GSLRng structure
gsl.gsl_rng_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
gsl.gsl_rng_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(GSLRng)

# gsl_rng_set initializes the RNG with a seed
gsl.gsl_rng_set.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(GSLRng), ctypes.c_ulong]
gsl.gsl_rng_set.restype = None

# gsl_rng_uniform returns a random double between 0 and 1
gsl.gsl_rng_uniform.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(GSLRng)]
gsl.gsl_rng_uniform.restype = ctypes.c_double

# gsl_rng_free releases the RNG memory
gsl.gsl_rng_free.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(GSLRng)]
gsl.gsl_rng_free.restype = None

# Define the RNG type (taus2)
gsl_rng_taus2 = ctypes.c_void_p.in_dll(gsl, "gsl_rng_taus2")

def generate_random_double(seed):
    """Generates a random double precision number using the GSL RNG."""
    # Allocate the RNG
    rng = gsl.gsl_rng_alloc(gsl_rng_taus2)
    if not rng:
        raise MemoryError("Failed to allocate RNG.")

    try:
        # Set the seed
        gsl.gsl_rng_set(rng, seed)

        # Generate a random double
        random_double = gsl.gsl_rng_uniform(rng)

    finally:
        # Free the RNG
        gsl.gsl_rng_free(rng)

    return random_double

def assert_test():
    """Test cases to validate the correctness of the solution."""
    # Test with a specific seed
    seed = 12345
    result = generate_random_double(seed)
    assert 0.0 <= result < 1.0, "Random double is out of range!"

    # Test with another seed
    seed = 67890
    result = generate_random_double(seed)
    assert 0.0 <= result < 1.0, "Random double is out of range!"

    # Test with edge case seed (0)
    seed = 0
    result = generate_random_double(seed)
    assert 0.0 <= result < 1.0, "Random double is out of range!"

    print("All tests passed.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
